title: Remove and refit the cylinder head
completeness: Complete bounded bench operation from the declared entry state to the declared exit state. Whole-bike access and downstream engine closure are separate dependencies.

source.review_note: All cited operation pages visually reviewed. General symbols and conditional torque rules retained.

applicability.included: Exact US2026 YZ450F standard stock components only
excluded: Head valve repair is a separately recorded dependency

required_tools.name: Calibrated torque wrench, angle measurement tool and marking pen

preflight: Engine-access and cam-removal states listed in the first step are already complete.
entry_state: Engine-access and cam-removal states listed in the first step are already complete.
exit_state: Cylinder head sealed and torqued; cam/tensioner installation and external engine closure still required.
critical_stop_conditions: Any required measurement unresolved or replacement criteria not satisfied.
Unidentified diagram orientation, missing parts, damage or abnormal binding.

material_policy.LT: Locking agent (LOCTITE) per PDF7. Grade unspecified by this manual; no grade inferred.
material_policy.lubrication: Follow each explicit E/M/LS/S application; general dry torque does not override a lubricated joint.

steps.title: Confirm head-removal access
steps.instruction: Start with the engine supported and cold, coolant drained, radiator hose and coolant-temperature coupler detached, throttle body and exhaust detached, upper engine bracket removed and cams/tensioner already removed. Secure the chain. Keep oil-passage plugs, studs and ground terminal installed for this bounded operation.
verification: Named access completed; chain secured; plugs/studs/terminal undisturbed.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Release the head in removal order
steps.instruction: Use the removal-order diagram, which is different from the installation diagram. Loosen the twoM6x45 and fourM10x129 head bolts half a turn each per pass, positions1 through6, until all are loose. Then remove bolts/washers and lift the head without letting the chain fall.
verification: Removal order and six bolts/washers accounted for.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Remove head sealing parts
steps.instruction: Remove the intake-side chain guide and old head gasket; retain both dowels. Check the guide for damage/wear and replace if defective. Keep the cylinder and piston supported; their service is a separate operation at this point.
verification: Guide, gasket and dowels accounted for.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Inspect the head before choosing reuse
steps.instruction: Clean carbon with a rounded scraper that cannot score the chamber or plug threads. Clear coolant-passage deposits. Check for damage/scratches; a replaced head also requires new valves. Measure warpage with straightedge and feeler gauge across the illustrated directions; limit0.05mm. Record all directions and the reuse/repair decision.
verification: Head condition and warpage readings saved.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Complete required head or cylinder work before refit
steps.instruction: The retained-head path requires satisfactory head/valve inspection. If head repair, valve/guide replacement or cylinder/piston service is needed, complete and document that work before proceeding. OEM describes400–600-grit figure-eight resurfacing on a surface plate, rotating the head for even removal, but gives no maximum material-removal depth here; do not invent a skim allowance.
verification: Head service disposition recorded; required repairs complete, or explicitly not needed.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Install the new head gasket and head
steps.instruction: Pull the chain upward while fitting the intake-side guide, both dowels, new gasket and head. Match the gasket orientation and openings to the illustration. Keep debris out of the cylinder and chain cavity.
verification: New gasket orientation, dowels and chain guide verified.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Prepare the four main head bolts
steps.instruction: Clean main-bolt threads/contact faces, both washer faces, head contact surfaces and crankcase threads. Apply molybdenum-disulfide grease to main-bolt threads/contact faces and both washer faces. Install main bolts/washers at positions1–4 in the installation diagram and seat lightly.
verification: Clean surfaces and all specified grease locations recorded.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Perform the first tightening stage
steps.instruction: Follow installation positions1–4, tightening evenly in two or three stages until all four reach36Nm. Keep the installation order visible; do not substitute the removal numbering.
verification: Each main bolt36Nm in order recorded.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Retighten only main bolt1
steps.instruction: Remove only bolt1 without loosening another bolt. Reapply molybdenum-disulfide grease to its threads/contact face and both washer faces, reinstall and tighten18Nm. Mark bolt/head as illustrated, then rotate bolt1 another90degrees. Finish this bolt before loosening bolt2.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Repeat one bolt at a time
steps.instruction: Perform the same remove, regrease,18Nm and90degree sequence for bolt2, then3, then4. Completely finish one before loosening the next. Record each bolt separately.
verification: Bolts2,3,4 each18Nm/+90degrees after individual regrease recorded.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Apply the final angle
steps.instruction: In installation order1–4, turn each main head bolt an additional60degrees. Record each final angle separately; this is not a single36Nm-plus-angle shortcut.
verification: Final60degrees for all four bolts recorded.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Secure the two small head bolts
steps.instruction: Install and tighten the two small head bolts at positions5 and6 to12Nm with LOCTITE locking agent. The manual does not name a grade. Verify all six completed fasteners and leave cams/tensioner installation for its next operation.
verification: Small bolts12Nm with locking agent; all six stages complete.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

runtime_integration_requirement: Enforce entry state and record_required. Completion certifies this bounded operation only; no automatic completion of upstream/downstream work.
